explanation.text: The SPHEREx and PUNCH launch occurred on March 11, 2025 from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, as confirmed by eoPortal spans 117-119 and NASA JPL/CalTech/Ball Aerospace sources. The assertion's claim of Kennedy Space Center is contradicted by evidence showing Vandenberg SFB as the launch.

The eoPortal source span 117-119 explicitly states the shared mission launched from 'Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at the Vandenberg Space Force Base, California on March 11, 2025.' Span 145 confirms the August 2022 rideshare arrangement.
Wikipedia evidence (IDs 5d19b054, ee14c1a2) correctly identifies Kennedy Space Center as being on Merritt Island, Florida, contradicting the assertion's California location claim.

excerpts.text:
## Launch

SPHEREx was launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at the Vandenberg Space Force Base, California on March 11, 2025. The launch was procured by NASA's Launch Services Program and was conducted as a shared mission with the Polarimeter to UNify the Corona and Heliosphere (PUNCH) spacecraft.

* August 03, 2022: NASA confirmed that SPHEREx will launch alongside the PUNCH (Polarimeter to Unify the Corona and Heliosphere) mission as a secondary rideshare payload. This decision optimizes launch costs and aligns with mission requirements. 13)
